title: skills-sh-microsoft-github-copilot-for-azure-azure-cost-optimization
summary: ## Azure Redis Cost Optimization Reference guide for identifying cost savings opportunities in Azure Redis deployments through analysis and targeted scans. ## Subscription Input Options Accept any of these identifiers to identify subscriptions for analysis: | Input Type | Example | Use Case | |------------|---------|----------| | **Subscription ID** | `a1b2c3d4-...` | Analyze specific subscription | | **Subscription Name** | `Production-Environment` | User-friendly identifier | | **Subscription Prefix** | `CacheTeam -` | Analyze all team subscriptions | | **Tenant ID** | `tenant-guid` | Analyze entire organization |
type: skills
